title: Hampi Boulder Trails & Vijayanagara Dynasties
badge: UNESCO World Heritage • Gandhi Jayanti Long Weekend
summary: A 3-day frictionless expedition across UNESCO World Heritage monolithic ruins, Tungabhadra river walks, sunrise atop Matanga Hill, sunset from Malyavanta & Hemakuta hills, and golden-hour bouldering at Sanapur Lake & Anjanadri.

locations.desc: Verified rental fleet right near Munirabad Station on Shivapur Rd / Huligi corridor. Phone: 087928 58466 (Linga Bhaiya / Ravi). Well-maintained Honda Activa 6G / Scooters (₹400–₹500/day). Pick up Day 1 morning (07:00 AM), return Day 3 evening (07:30 PM) before heading to Hosapete.

locations.name: Sri Durga Comfort Stay, Hampi (Sanapur)
locations.desc: Finalized stay! Highly rated 5.0★ homestay run by Durga & Raj near Sunrise Road, Sanapur. Peaceful boulder surroundings, hot water, safe scooter parking, and homemade meals. Only 1.5 km to Sanapur Lake and 4.2 km to Anjanadri Hill. Phone: 063623 28833.

locations.name: Virupaksha Temple & Hampi Bazaar
locations.desc: Active 7th-century Dravidian temple complex dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring a 50m gopuram, inverted pinhole shadow camera, and historic pillared bazaar street. (Note: Elephant Lakshmi was relocated in late May 2026 to the Malur Elephant Care Facility for veterinary rehabilitation; blessings are no longer offered).

locations.name: Sasivekalu & Kadalekalu Ganesha
locations.desc: Colossal monolithic Ganesha statues carved from single boulders (Kadalekalu 4.6m and Sasivekalu 2.4m), best visited late afternoon when granite rocks cool down, immediately leading into the Hemakuta sunset.

locations.name: Mango Tree Restaurant
locations.desc: Iconic multi-cuisine cafe serving authentic South Indian thalis, wood-fired pizzas, banana lassi, and iced coffee.

locations.name: Hemakuta Hill Sunset Point
locations.desc: Gentle granite slope dotted with 30+ pre-Vijayanagara stone shrines. Watch the sky turn gold over Virupaksha and the boulder horizon.

locations.name: Vijaya Vittala Temple & Stone Chariot
locations.desc: UNESCO crown jewel of Vijayanagara architecture featuring the world-famous Stone Chariot, musical pillars, and ornate Ranga Mantapa carvings.
locations.bookingParams: Monument: Group of Monuments at Hampi (Vittala + Lotus Mahal) • Pass: ₹50 / Indian National

locations.name: Lotus Mahal, Elephant Stables & Queen's Bath
locations.desc: Indo-Islamic secular architecture in the Zenana Enclosure: recessed archways of Lotus Mahal, 11-domed royal elephant stables, and stepped water tanks.
locations.bookingParams: Monument: Group of Monuments at Hampi (Vittala + Lotus Mahal) • Pass: ₹50 / Indian National

locations.name: Matanga Hill Ridge
locations.desc: Highest vantage in central Hampi with 360-degree aerial panorama over Achyutaraya temple and Tungabhadra valley. Strictly a morning/sunrise climb for safety in natural daylight.

locations.name: Sanapur Lake & Tungabhadra Coracle Ride
locations.desc: Tranquil reservoir surrounded by granite boulder stacks. Enjoy a circular coracle boat ride (₹400) and boulder cliff walks.

locations.name: Anjanadri Hill (Anegundi)
locations.desc: Mythological birthplace of Lord Hanuman. 575 stone steps climbed during breezy golden hour sunset for panoramic views over river loops and boulder valleys.

locations.name: Malyavanta Raghunatha Hill Sunset
locations.desc: 16th-century Rama temple perched on boulder hill. Renowned for continuous centuries-old Ramayana chanting and safe, panoramic sunset ledges with paved road descent.

locations.name: Shaded Riverside Walk & Tungabhadra Coracle
locations.desc: Shaded boulder-paved riverside trail connecting Virupaksha to Kodandarama Temple. Features calm morning coracle floats on the Tungabhadra River.

locations.name: Anegundi Heritage Village & Crafts
locations.desc: Historic village older than Hampi: Gagan Mahal palace ruins, Chintamani Temple cave complex, and banana-fiber craft workshops.

locations.name: Lakshmi Narasimha & Badavilinga Monoliths
locations.desc: Colossal 6.7m monolithic Narasimha seated on the coils of 7-hooded Adisesha serpent, alongside the 3m monolithic Badavilinga permanently standing in canal spring water.

locations.name: Krishna Temple & Sacred Pushkarani Bazaar
locations.desc: Built in 1513 CE by Emperor Krishnadevaraya after the Utkala victory. Features intricate Dashavatara Vishnu carvings and an expansive sacred stepped bazaar tank.

locations.name: Queen's Bath (Royal Aquatic Pavilion)
locations.desc: Indo-Islamic royal aquatic pavilion surrounded by a water moat, featuring ornate arched overhanging balconies and decorative Islamic stucco ceiling motifs.

locations.name: Underground Shiva Temple (Prasanna Virupaksha)
locations.desc: Sunken below ground level, this historic sanctuary is continually surrounded by cool natural spring water fed from the ancient Tungabhadra irrigation canals.

locations.name: King's Court & Stepped Pushkarani Tank
locations.desc: The ceremonial heart of the Vijayanagara Empire: the massive 3-tiered Mahanavami Dibba platform adorned with military reliefs, and the perfectly geometric black-schist stepped Pushkarini water tank fed by ancient aqueducts.

locations.name: Sunrise Tungabhadra Coracle Boating
locations.desc: Atmospheric early-morning circular coracle float across the gentle waters of the Tungabhadra river surrounded by ancient granite boulders and river ruins. Licensed operators with mandatory lifejackets.

locations.name: Monkey Zone & Golden Boulders Climbing
locations.desc: Hampi is internationally famed as one of the world's premier granite bouldering destinations. Professional instructors at Monkey Zone and Golden Boulders provide crash-pad rentals, climbing shoes, chalk bags, and guided beginner bouldering sessions across classic problem lines.

locations.name: Anegundi & Sanapur Paddy-Field Cafes
locations.desc: Chilled-out dining spots set amidst lush green paddy fields and granite boulders (Rock n Chill, Laughing Buddha, Anegundi Garden Cafe). Known for wood-fired thin crust pizzas, fresh fruit shakes, iced teas, and acoustic jam sessions in the afternoon.

locations.name: Onake Kindi Cave Art & Hire Benakal Dolmens
locations.desc: Rare prehistoric sites for heritage enthusiasts: Onake Kindi features red and white ochre rock art depicting human and animal figures inside natural boulder shelters. Hire Benakal (~30 km away) is India's largest megalithic site with over 400 prehistoric stone dolmens and burial chambers dating back to 800 BCE.

locations.name: Hosapete Central Bus Stand
locations.desc: Primary transit hub connecting Hampi to Bengaluru. Day 1 arrival at 06:15 AM (KSRTC Non AC Sleeper PNR KK22992248, Seats 8 & 7); Day 3 boarding at 22:45 hrs on Platform 0 (KSRTC Pallakki Sleeper PNR KS23020219, Seats 11 & 12).

events.title: Arrival at Hosapete Central Bus Stand from Bengaluru
events.desc: Arrive via KSRTC Non AC Sleeper (Departed Majestic 11:14 PM, PNR: KK22992248, TripCode: 2314BNGHSP, Seats 8 & 7). Fresh early morning weather in Hosapete.
events.tip: Restroom and tea stalls available inside Hosapete KSRTC Bus Stand. Head to auto stand for transfer to Munirabad.

events.title: Auto Transfer: Hosapete Bus Stand ➔ Munirabad Station
events.desc: Take a 15–20 min auto (~14 km via NH67 / Ballari-Hubballi Rd) from Hosapete Central Bus Stand to Ravi Bike Rental at Munirabad Railway Station (Huligi corridor). Fare is ~₹200–₹250.
events.tip: Call rental coordinator Linga Bhaiya / Ravi (+91 87928 58466) upon leaving Hosapete bus stand so scooter is fueled and inspected ready.

events.title: Scooter Handover, Inspection & Helmets at Ravi Bike Rental
events.desc: Complete rental formalities with Linga Bhaiya / Ravi (Phone: 087928 58466). Inspect Honda Activa 6G, test brakes and headlights, record a 360° walkaround video, and collect 2 ISI helmets. Rate: ₹400–₹500/day.
events.tip: Top up petrol at the nearby fuel station before heading north towards Sanapur. Keep phone holder or mount secure.

events.title: Scenic Morning Ride to Sri Durga Comfort Stay (Sanapur)
events.desc: Enjoy a tranquil 14.4 km morning ride (24 mins) along Huligi-Gangavathi Road cutting directly into the North Hampi boulder belt. Arrive at Sri Durga Comfort Stay on Sunrise Road, Sanapur. Drop bags with welcoming hosts Durga & Raj, freshen up in guest facilities, and enjoy hot home-cooked idli, vada, and tea.
events.tip: Hosts Durga & Raj (+91 63623 28833) are super hospitable; ask them for today's ferry timings or take the bridge route.

events.title: Ride to Sacred Center (Virupaksha Temple via Anegundi Bridge)
events.desc: Ride scooter across the scenic Anegundi Bridge connecting North and South Hampi (or take 5-min scooter ride to Virupapur Gaddi ferry point and hop on the 2-minute passenger ferry boat across Tungabhadra to Virupaksha Ghat). Park scooter at Virupaksha designated two-wheeler parking.
events.tip: The bridge route offers sweeping morning views over the Tungabhadra river valley.

events.title: Virupaksha Temple Darshan & Pillared Hampi Bazaar Walk
events.desc: Explore the functioning 7th-century Dravidian temple complex dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring the majestic 50m eastern gopuram, intricate ceiling murals, and the famous inverted pinhole camera shadow phenomenon in the rear sanctum. (Note: Elephant Lakshmi was relocated in late May 2026 to the Malur Elephant Care Facility for veterinary rehabilitation; blessings are no longer offered). Walk down the ancient 750m pillared Hampi Bazaar.
events.tip: Shoe deposit available outside eastern gopuram (₹5). Dress code requires shoulders and knees covered.

events.title: Krishna Temple & Sacred Pushkarani Bazaar
events.desc: Built in 1513 CE by Emperor Krishnadevaraya to celebrate the conquest of Udayagiri (Orissa). Marvel at the exquisitely carved pillars depicting the 10 incarnations of Vishnu (Dashavatara), the open mukhamantapa, and walk across to the expansive stepped Pushkarani water tank and pillared market avenue.
events.tip: Notice the rare inverted lotus motif carvings on the ceiling of the main mahamantapa.

events.title: Shaded Riverside Trail & Tungabhadra Walk
events.desc: Stroll along the shaded boulder path alongside the sacred Tungabhadra River connecting Virupaksha to Kodandarama Temple. The natural river breeze and boulder shade provide natural heat relief before noon.
events.tip: Carry fresh tender coconut water; local vendors along the riverside trail sell sweet Balamuri coconuts.

events.title: Relaxed Lunch at Mango Tree Restaurant
events.desc: Authentic North Karnataka Jolada Rotti meals, thalis, fresh lime mint coolers, and fruit desserts.
events.tip: Indoor seating has AC; perfect to avoid the peak afternoon heat (1:00 PM to 3:30 PM).

events.title: Midday Heat Avoidance & Shaded Relaxation
events.desc: Avoid granite skillet heat during the 32°C peak hours. Relax at Mango Tree's shaded lounge or ride back to Sri Durga Comfort Stay to unpack, take a shower, and recharge.
events.tip: Charge phones and power banks to 100% for the afternoon monolithic circuit and golden hour sunset.

events.title: Lakshmi Narasimha (Ugra Narasimha) & Badavilinga Monoliths
events.desc: Stand before Hampi's largest monolithic sculpture: the 6.7m high Ugra Narasimha, masterfully hewn from a single granite boulder in 1528 CE, depicting Lord Vishnu seated on the giant coils of the seven-hooded serpent Adisesha. Just steps away, visit the 3m monolithic Badavilinga, permanently submerged in canal spring water commissioned by a poor peasant woman.
events.tip: Late afternoon light illuminates Narasimha's fierce facial features; the cool spring water at Badavilinga provides refreshing ambient air.

events.title: Monolithic Sasivekalu & Kadalekalu Ganeshas
events.desc: Walk up to the two colossal monolithic Ganesha statues. Sasivekalu (mustard seed, 2.4m) stands in an open pavilion depicting Ganesha with a snake tied around his belly; Kadalekalu (gram seed, 4.6m) stands with slender carved pillars.
events.tip: Kadalekalu pavilion offers an elevated view of the Virupaksha tower and banana plantations.

events.title: Hemakuta Hill Sunset Panorama
events.desc: Walk onto the gentle granite slope of Hemakuta Hill, dotted with over 30 pre-Vijayanagara triple-chambered shrines. Watch the sky turn gold over Virupaksha and the boulder horizon.
events.tip: Bring a torch/phone light for walking down after the sun dips at 6:15 PM.

events.title: Scenic Dusk Ride to Sanapur & Dinner at North Hampi Cafes
events.desc: Ride scooter across Anegundi Bridge back to North Hampi (Sanapur). Head to iconic paddy-field cafes like Laughing Buddha or Rock n Chill for wood-fired pizzas, lemon ginger tea, and acoustic vibes. Return to Sri Durga Comfort Stay for a peaceful night amidst boulder silhouettes.
events.tip: The ride across Anegundi bridge at dusk is breezy and pleasant. Drive safely with headlight on.

events.title: Breakfast at Sri Durga Comfort Stay & Morning Ride
events.desc: Start the day with fresh home-cooked South Indian breakfast prepared by hosts Durga & Raj. Mount your scooter for an 18 km morning ride across Anegundi Bridge directly to the Vijaya Vittala parking area.
events.tip: Arriving right at 08:00 AM ensures crowd-free photos at the Stone Chariot before tour buses arrive.

events.title: Vijaya Vittala Temple & The Iconic Stone Chariot
events.desc: Arrive early at Vittala complex. Take the pollution-free battery buggy from parking. Marvel at the 16th-century Stone Chariot (featured on ₹50 currency note) and the 56 monolithic musical pillars of the Ranga Mantapa.
events.tip: Single ASI ticket (₹50) covers Vittala Temple and the Lotus Mahal/Zenana Enclosure on the same day.

events.title: Lunch in Kamalapura / Mayura Bhuvaneshwari
events.desc: South Indian vegetarian thali, bisi bele bath, and cooling curd rice at KSTDC Mayura restaurant in Kamalapura.
events.tip: Hydrate with fresh tender coconut water available in abundance near the parking.

events.title: Queen's Bath (Royal Aquatic Pavilion)
events.desc: Begin the Royal Center tour at the Queen's Bath. Marvel at the unique Indo-Islamic architecture, surrounded by an ancient protective water moat, with ornate overhanging jharokha balconies, vaulted corridors, and a central lotus-shaped sunken pool where royal women bathed in scented waters.
events.tip: Look up at the intricate vaulted ceiling stucco work showcasing floral arabesques and Persian geometric arches.

events.title: Lotus Mahal & Royal Elephant Stables (Zenana Enclosure)
events.desc: Tour the women's secular palace quarters: the two-story Lotus Mahal with multi-layered lotus-petal archways and ancient terracotta cooling channels, and the grand 11-domed royal Elephant Stables with alternating Islamic and Hindu domes.
events.tip: Your morning Vittala ASI entry QR ticket is scanned at the Zenana gate for free entry.

events.title: King's Court, Mahanavami Dibba & Stepped Tank (Pushkarani)
events.desc: Explore the ceremonial heart of the Vijayanagara Empire: climb the massive 3-tiered Mahanavami Dibba platform adorned with military reliefs, and admire the perfectly geometric black-schist stepped Pushkarini water tank fed by ancient stone aqueducts.
events.tip: Climb the steps of Mahanavami Dibba for an elevated view across the foundations of the King's Audience Hall.

events.title: Underground Shiva Temple (Prasanna Virupaksha)
events.desc: Discover the sunken, subterranean sanctuary of Prasanna Virupaksha. Built several meters below ground level, this historic temple's pillared halls and inner sanctum are continually surrounded by cool, natural spring water fed by ancient underground canals.
events.tip: Wade through the ankle-deep, refreshing cool water towards the inner sanctum — a unique and atmospheric experience.

events.title: Malyavanta Raghunatha Hill Sunset
events.desc: 16th-century Rama temple perched on boulder hill. Renowned for continuous centuries-old Ramayana chanting and safe, panoramic sunset ledges with paved road descent.
events.tip: Unlike Matanga Hill, Malyavanta has a paved motorable road right up to the courtyard, eliminating dangerous dusk boulder descents.

events.title: Evening Ride Across Bridge & Dinner at The Goan Corner
events.desc: Ride back across Anegundi Bridge into Sanapur. Enjoy dinner at The Goan Corner or Anegundi Garden Cafe (creamy hummus, falafel platters, wood-fired thin-crust pizza, and fresh smoothies).
events.tip: Night 2 at Sri Durga Comfort Stay. Prepare daypack for Day 3 checkout and Sanapur bouldering.

events.title: Sanapur Lake Sunrise Ridge Walk
events.desc: Wake up to fresh morning air in Sanapur. Take a 3-minute scooter ride (1.5 km) from Sri Durga Comfort Stay to Sanapur Lake for a peaceful morning boulder stroll as the sun lights up the granite ridges.
events.tip: Wear rubber-traction sneakers for safe boulder walking. Incredible golden reflections on the reservoir water.

events.title: Breakfast at Sri Durga Comfort Stay & Baggage Storage
events.desc: Enjoy breakfast prepared by Durga & Raj. Complete room checkout, pack a light daypack with essentials (sunscreen, sunglasses, power bank, bus clothes), and leave heavy luggage stored safely at Sri Durga Comfort Stay.
events.tip: Hosts Durga & Raj will keep your bags safely stored in the guest room/office until you return this evening.

events.title: Sanapur Lake Boulder Reservoir & Coracle Boating
events.desc: Tranquil reservoir surrounded by giant granite boulder stacks. Enjoy a traditional circular coracle boat ride (₹400–₹500 for two) through the canal gorge with licensed boatmen. CRITICAL SAFETY ADVISORY: Strict prohibition against swimming or cliff jumping due to hidden granite rock shelves and official warning signs of mugger crocodiles (Crocodylus palustris).
events.tip: Always wear the provided certified lifejacket. Ask the boatman for a gentle 360° spin in the calm gorge waters.

events.title: Bouldering with Certified Instructors (Monkey Zone / Golden Boulders)
events.desc: Hampi is internationally famed as one of the world's premier granite bouldering destinations. Professional instructors at Monkey Zone and Golden Boulders provide crash-pad rentals, climbing shoes, chalk bags, and guided beginner bouldering sessions across classic problem lines.
events.tip: Even beginners can try low-height boulder problems under the supervision of local instructors.

events.title: Paddy-field Cafe Lunch & Chilling (Rock n Chill / Laughing Buddha)
events.desc: Relax at one of Anegundi's chilled-out riverside paddy cafes (Rock n Chill, Laughing Buddha, or Anegundi Garden Cafe). Enjoy wood-fired thin crust pizzas, fresh fruit juices, and acoustic jam vibes.
events.tip: Try the fresh ginger lemon iced tea or cold coffee after morning bouldering.

events.title: Anegundi Heritage Village & Banana-Fiber Crafts
events.desc: Explore historic Anegundi, older than Vijayanagara: Gagan Mahal palace ruins, Chintamani Temple cave complex where Sugriva showed Rama Sita's jewels, and the Kishkinda Trust banana-fiber craft workshops.
events.tip: Support local women artisans by purchasing eco-friendly handwoven banana-fiber bags, mats, and coasters.

events.title: Anjanadri Hill (Hanuman Birthplace) Golden Hour Sunset
events.desc: Located just 4.2 km from your stay in Sanapur! Tackle the 575 stone steps during the breezy 4:30 PM golden hour. Reach the summit temple for breathtaking 360-degree sunset panoramas across emerald paddy fields, the meandering Tungabhadra, and endless boulder valleys.
events.tip: Beware of mischievous monkeys near summit; keep sunglasses, caps, and water bottles inside zipped backpacks. Descend during twilight.

events.title: Retrieve Backpacks at Sri Durga Comfort Stay & Freshen Up
events.desc: Quick 10-minute ride back to Sri Durga Comfort Stay (4.2 km). Collect your stored backpacks from Durga & Raj, freshen up in the guest washroom, change into comfortable night travel attire, and bid farewell to your hosts.
events.tip: Secure heavy rucksacks to the scooter footboard before starting the 14.4 km ride to Munirabad.

events.title: Scenic Evening Ride: Sanapur ➔ Ravi Bike Rental (Munirabad)
events.desc: Smooth 14.4 km evening ride (24 mins) along Huligi-Gangavathi Road from Sanapur straight to Ravi Bike Rental at Munirabad Railway Station. Paved state corridor with cool dusk breeze.
events.tip: Ride at a steady 40 km/h pace; scooter headlights are bright and traffic is light along this rural stretch.

events.title: Scooter Handover & Deposit Refund at Ravi Bike Rental
events.desc: Hand over Honda Activa to Linga Bhaiya / Ravi (Phone: 087928 58466) at Munirabad Station. Quick 5-minute visual check, return both ISI helmets, and collect your refundable security deposit / original ID card.
events.tip: Rental handover is smooth and hassle-free.

events.title: Auto Transfer: Munirabad Station ➔ Hosapete Central Bus Stand
events.desc: Take a 20-min auto (~14 km via NH67) from Munirabad Station directly into Hosapete Central Bus Stand. Fare is ~₹200–₹250.
events.tip: Autos are readily available right at Munirabad Station road. You will arrive in Hosapete with over 2.5 hours before bus departure!

events.title: Celebratory Dinner in Hosapete Town (Waves / Priyadarshini Pride)
events.desc: Relaxed sit-down farewell dinner within walking distance of Hosapete Bus Stand: Waves Restaurant or Hotel Priyadarshini Pride Udupi Veg. Enjoy hot North Karnataka Jolada Rotti meals, paneer butter masala, jeera rice, and filter coffee. Pick up packaged snacks and two 1L sealed water bottles for the journey.
events.tip: Eat light before overnight sleeper bus journey. The restaurants have clean air-conditioned family dining and restrooms.

events.title: Board KSRTC Pallakki Sleeper Bus to Bengaluru
events.desc: Enter Hosapete Central Bus Stand Platform No. 0. Board KSRTC Pallakki Non AC Sleeper (Departing 22:45 hrs / 10:45 PM, TripCode: 2132GVTBNG, PNR: KS23020219, Seats 11 & 12, Transaction Password: 4126).
events.tip: Confirmed booking under passenger name ABHAV THAKUR. Keep SMS/WhatsApp M-ticket ready for conductor verification.

events.title: Arrival at Bengaluru (Majestic Terminal 1) ➔ Cab to Bellandur
events.desc: Bus arrives at Kempegowda Bus Station (Majestic Terminal 1) at approximately 06:00 AM Monday morning. Book a quick Uber/Ola cab back to Bellandur (25–30 mins via early morning empty roads), arriving home refreshed with zero weekend fatigue!
events.tip: Pre-book cab as the bus enters Yeshwantpur/Rajajinagar for seamless pickup at Majestic Terminal 1.

items.text: Original Driving License (Physical Card / DigiLocker / mParivahan)
items.desc: Mandatory to present before taking handover of Honda Activa scooter from Ravi Bike Rental at Munirabad Station (Phone: 087928 58466).
Take a 30-second timestamped video showing body scratches, tire tread depth, odometer, mirror clamps, and headlight function before riding away.
Karnataka state traffic police enforce mandatory helmets for both rider and pillion on state highways and Kamalapura checkpoints.
Agreed rate: ₹450/day for Honda Activa from Ravi Bike Rental at Munirabad Station. Fill fuel at IndianOil/HP pumps along Shivapur Rd / Huligi corridor or Kamalapura.

items.text: Save Rental Breakdown & Host Contacts Offline
items.desc: Saved emergency contacts: Ravi Bike Rental / Linga Bhaiya (+91 87928 58466) and Sri Durga Comfort Stay hosts Durga & Raj (+91 63623 28833).

checklist.phase: Phase 2: Important Things to Carry (Sun, Weather & Boulders)

items.desc: Essential for safe friction on slick granite boulders at Matanga Hill, Hemakuta, and 575 stone steps at Anjanadri. No smooth-soled shoes or flip-flops.
Crucial protection against intense radiant heat reflecting off open granite boulders (Sasivekalu, Kadalekalu, Vittala).
High UV glare cuts visibility across vast granite rock sheets and Tungabhadra waters.

items.text: High SPF 50+ Broad-Spectrum Sunscreen & Lip Balm
items.desc: Reapply every 2.5–3 hours. Hampi's October afternoon sun can reach 32°C with high UV index.
Maintain continuous hydration. Fill up before leaving Sri Durga Comfort Stay each morning.

items.text: Lightweight Breathable Cotton Attire (Modest Dress Code)
items.desc: Loose-fitting cottons covering shoulders and knees are required for entry into the active sanctum of Sri Virupaksha Temple.
Keep water, phone, and essentials safely zipped while riding scooter or climbing granite steps.

items.text: Original Govt Photo ID (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
items.desc: Required for KSRTC bus conductor verification, homestay check-in, and ASI monument security gates.

items.text: Confirmed KSRTC Sleeper M-Tickets Saved Offline
items.desc: Outbound: BLR ➔ Hosapete (PNR: KK22992248, TripCode: 2314BNGHSP, Seats 8 & 7, Majestic P15, 23:14 hrs). Return: Hosapete ➔ BLR (PNR: KS23020219, TripCode: 2132GVTBNG, Seats 11 & 12, Hosapete P0, 22:45 hrs).
Single ₹50 ASI ticket covers both Vijaya Vittala Temple and Lotus Mahal / Zenana Enclosure on the same calendar day. Download QR codes offline.
Download offline map for Hosapete, Munirabad, Sanapur Lake, Anegundi, and Kamalapura to navigate through cellular deadzones.

items.text: Sri Durga Comfort Stay Booking Confirmation
items.desc: Confirmed 2-night homestay booking in Sanapur boulder belt. Hosts Durga & Raj (+91 63623 28833). Early bag drop scheduled for 08:00 AM Oct 2.

checklist.phase: Phase 4: Health, Hydration & Boulder First Aid

items.text: Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS / Electral Sachets - 6 Packets)
items.desc: Add to water bottles during morning and afternoon ruin explorations to prevent heat exhaustion and muscle cramping.
Critical for sudden heel or toe friction blisters when climbing 575 stone steps at Anjanadri Hill.

items.text: Pain Relief Spray or Roll-on Gel (Volini / Moov)
items.desc: Quick relief for calf muscle tightness and knee fatigue after sunset climbs.
Apply during evening riverside strolls, Tungabhadra breeze, and twilight outdoor dinners in Sanapur.
Carry basic travel pharmaceuticals; limited medical store access inside the core monument zone.
Continuous GPS navigation on scooter and high-res photography drain phone batteries within 5 hours.
Airborne granite dust quickly coats smartphone and camera lenses; keep clean for crisp golden hour shots.

items.text: Waterproof Floating Phone Pouch for Coracle Rides
items.desc: Mandatory splash protection during Tungabhadra River and Sanapur Lake circular coracle floats.
Vital for safe descent from Hemakuta Hill after twilight and early-morning Matanga Hill dawn climbs.
Essential for temple shoe deposit counters (₹5), tender coconuts (₹40–₹50), parking, and coracle boatmen (₹400–₹500) where mobile UPI network drops.

items.text: Zipped Monkey-Proof Pouch for Loose Items
items.desc: Troops of rhesus macaques frequent Anjanadri Hill and Virupaksha gopuram; secure snacks, sunglasses, and water bottles inside zipped compartments.
